Urban-Economic Geography

certificate
  • Home
  • Undergraduate Catalog
  • Colleges and Schools
  • Liberal Arts and Sciences | College of
  • Urban-Economic Geography Certificate

The Urban-Economic Geography Certificates covers topics concerning urbanization, economic development, and spatial distribution of resources and populations. It integrates theories and methodologies in urban growth dynamics, economic principles, and spatial analysis. Additionally, the certificate fosters practical applications to develop skills in GIS and fieldwork and qualitative research methods.

Department Information

The Geography Department offers a range of topics in contemporary geography and geospatial science, rich and lively cultural and learning environments, BA and BS undergraduate degrees, MA, M.S., and PhD degrees, as well as the largest Medical Geography program in the United States.
